notes: Code is the official displayed order code; id is the separate API service identifier. Do not truncate codes ending 9999.
The profiles refer storage to component tests; collection guidance is paired with the general specimen guide.
The specimen guide mixes rpm and g in centrifuge tables; use validated tube and centrifuge settings.
No universal fasting duration is stated for the six basic panel families. cPL combinations request overnight fasting; fPL combinations prefer fasting serum.
Canine 2665 uses the specimen field (EDTA plasma), despite legacy serum wording elsewhere in its record. Interpretation cutoffs were not imported.
